reason: #845 completed the exhaustive residual-five historical reconciliation and pre-RC Delta discovery without finding a fresh executable source defect. Four imported P0 rows and one imported P1 row remain mechanically blocked only because the current release state machine has no terminal disposition for an immutable Known Finding whose defect premise is contradicted by the audit-baseline source or cannot be reduced to an actionable historical root after exhaustive evidence review, while current mandatory contracts pass and no current P0/P1 root exists. Keeping such rows forever in EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION would either deadlock Lane D or incentivize synthetic RED/root evidence, both forbidden. This package therefore authorizes a narrow documentation/governance state-machine extension and ledger reconciliation for a strict VERIFIED_NON_DEFECT disposition. It may not weaken any real finding, may not rewrite the immutable 2026-08-20 finding text, and may not authorize RC/UAT, release or publish by itself.
